'''Maysano''' was a wanted [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] criminal who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Maysano had a file in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="A" /> When the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] lost her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]], she and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] librarian [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] briefly considered Maysano as a suspect.<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> At another point during the war, Tano consulted Maysano's file in the library while investigating a possible [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of which she had experienced fleeting [[Farsight/Legends|visions]]. According to Maysano's file, the Lutrillian was wanted for [[Death/Legends|murder]] and last had been spotted on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The mugshot accompanying the file showed Maysano as a [[Color/Legends|white]]-skinned Lutrillian with gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and pink [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], wearing a gray sweater and a brown jacket.<ref name="A" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maysano first appeared on a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] screen in "[[Lightsaber Lost]],"<ref name="LL" /> the eleventh episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' that aired on [[January 22]], [[2010]],<ref name="Lightsaber Lost Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> with the character's name being displayed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="LL" />
